_artifact: OCG chaingraph_export:xbrl-csv (§13.14) — EBA DPM 2.0 COREP concept-map SCAFFOLD, Annex 2
_status: UNPOPULATED. Maps OCG tool output fields to PUBLIC COREP template/row references, same as exporters/taxonomies/eba-corep-concept-map.json (§13.8, XBRL 2.1 XML wire format) — this file is the xBRL-CSV (DPM 2.0) sibling. The machine-readable DPM 2.0 metric qnames (eba_met), dimensional members, entry-point schemaRefs, and exact table/row/col coordinates MUST be populated from the published EBA RF 4.0 DPM 2.0 taxonomy package before this is used to emit a submission-shaped report. DO NOT FABRICATE eba_met qnames (OCG Standard §13.14 / §13.8 / core project rule). Until eba_qname is populated, a build against these taxonomies MUST return a 'pending' error and the ocg-ext table template is used instead — see fixtures/xbrl-csv/annex2-eba-dpm-corep.pending.json for the minimal fixture the §15 gate reads.

source_of_truth.note: Download the COREP / Liquidity entry points + the DPM 2.0 dictionary; bind each eba_qname below to the taxonomy's metric (eba_met:*) and dimensional members, and each table below to its DPM 2.0 tableTemplates definition. Confirm every template/row reference against the ITS Annexes (templates) and Annex II (instructions) — identical source documents to the §13.8 XML map, different wire-format binding.

conventions.ratios: report as decimals where the taxonomy item is a percentage/decimal; confirm scale per item
conventions.row_id_column: each DPM 2.0 tableTemplate declares its own row-id column (the §13.14.1 sort key) — confirm per template, not assumed to be 'concept' as the ocg-ext pilot template uses
